PR surface: Source +61, Tests +50. Total +111 across 5 files.

target.title: fix(mattermost): cap opaque, outbound, and monitor resource caches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded in-process Maps across three Mattermost runtime surfaces:

| Surface | Maps | Pre-fix behavior |
|---------|------|------------------|
| **Monitor** (`monitor-resources.ts`) | per-monitor `channelCache`, `userCache` | TTL-based reuse but **no size cap** |
| **Outbound send** (`send.ts`) | `botUserCache`, `userByNameCache`, `channelByNameCache`, `dmChannelCache` | Grew with every distinct `(baseUrl, token, target)` triple |
| **Opaque target resolution** (`target-resolution.ts`) | `mattermostOpaqueTargetCache` | 26-char ID lookups cached forever |

**Concrete example:** A busy Mattermost gateway monitoring 2 000 channels and resolving 3 000 opaque user IDs retains thousands of monitor + opaque cache entries indefinitely, plus unbounded outbound resolution caches under multi-recipient routing.

## Why This Change Was Made

Centralizes cache writes through helpers that call `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` immediately after each `.set`:

| Cache | Cap | File |
|-------|-----|------|
| Monitor `channelCache` | **1000** | `monitor-resources.ts` |
| Monitor `userCache` | **1000** | `monitor-resources.ts` |
| Outbound `botUserCache` | **256** | `send.ts` via `cacheOutboundEntry` |
| Outbound `userByNameCache` | **1024** | `send.ts` |
| Outbound `channelByNameCache` | **1024** | `send.ts` |
| Outbound `dmChannelCache` | **1024** | `send.ts` |
| Opaque `mattermostOpaqueTargetCache` | **1024** | `target-resolution.ts` |

TTL semantics for monitor caches are unchanged; eviction only bounds maximum retained entries.

## User Impact

**Before:** Mattermost-connected gateways accumulate unbounded in-process cache memory on long uptimes.

**After:** Each cache is capped; oldest insertion-order entries evict once limits are exceeded. Evicted entries behave like a cache miss (re-fetch / re-resolve on next use).

## Evidence

- `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-resources.ts:47–48,95–110` — monitor cache caps + `setCachedValue` prune
- `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/send.ts:71–86` — outbound caps + shared `cacheOutboundEntry`
- `extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/target-resolution.ts:19–25` — opaque target cap + `cacheMattermostOpaqueTarget`
- `src/infra/map-size.ts` — shared `pruneMapToMaxSize` implementation
- Diff: +123/−12 across five files; regressions in `monitor-resources.test.ts` and `target-resolution.test.ts`

### Behavior proof

All tests below were run against the current PR head commit `95aeb011951b297918f45efcccff3b93dbd97c9b` on Node v22.22.0, pnpm 11.2.2 (macOS Darwin 24.3.0 arm64, 2026-07-08T04:42:59Z). The head SHA matches the branch tip and can be independently reproduced by checking out this commit and running the same commands.

#### 1) Monitor channel cache eviction — verbose

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-resources.test.ts -t "evicts oldest" --reporter=verbose

 RUN  v4.1.9

 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > keeps media-only download failures visible to the agent
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > preserves successful media placeholders on partial failures
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > downloads media, preserves auth headers, and infers media kind
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > caches channel and user lookups and falls back to empty picker props
 ✓ |extension-mattermost| extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor-resources.test.ts > mattermost monitor resources > evicts oldest channel cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap 5ms
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > does not reuse cached lookups while the process clock is invalid
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > does not cache lookups when cache expiry would exceed the Date range
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > proxies typing indicators to the mattermost client helper

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 7 skipped (8)
   Start at  12:43:17
   Duration  3.61s (transform 2.09s, setup 115ms, import 3ms, tests 3.43s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 7.00s
```

Regression flow (`createMattermostMonitorResources` → `resolveChannelInfo`):

1. Resolve `chan-0` → `fetchMattermostChannel` **1×**
2. Resolve `chan-1` … `chan-1000` → **1000** more API calls (**1001** total)
3. Re-resolve `chan-0` → `fetchMattermostChannel` **1×** again (oldest monitor channel entry evicted, confirming cap at 1000)

#### 2) Opaque target cache eviction — verbose

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/target-resolution.test.ts -t "evicts oldest" --reporter=verbose

 RUN  v4.1.9

 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > recognizes explicit targets and ID-shaped values
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > resolves opaque ids as users and caches the result
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > falls back to channel targets on 404 lookups
 ↓ |extension-mattermost| ... > uses account resolution when token/base url are not passed
 ✓ |extension-mattermost| extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/target-resolution.test.ts > mattermost target resolution > evicts oldest opaque target cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap 28ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 4 skipped (5)
   Start at  12:43:28
   Duration  265ms (transform 147ms, setup 107ms, import 2ms, tests 87ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 3.32s
```

Regression flow (`resolveMattermostOpaqueTarget`):

1. Resolve first 26-char id (`a…a`) → `fetchMattermostUser` **1×**
2. Resolve **1024** additional opaque ids → **1025** total user lookups
3. Re-resolve first id → `fetchMattermostUser` **1×** again (oldest opaque cache entry evicted, confirming cap at 1024)
